verdict_plain: The kill at stand-in values is confirmed: my own exact code reproduces every headline number. One step is wrong as stated: the locality lemma (S1) fails for six-link open paths on a girth-six host, so the order-h^12 flip price per ring must subtract the weights of the six paths obtained by opening the ring. That raises the flippable ring's own price from +2.05e-10 to +2.84e-10 J6, turns the other classes' tiny costs into tiny gains, and changes the flip-strength lever from 17.8 to 25.0 (h/Ud)^6. The kill margin also depends on how class prices are projected onto the ring-flip form: 4.1e-4 J6 (seat's frozen projection) or 1.4e-2 J6 (least squares over the same 183,384 patterns). Both are RK sign and below the 0.1 J6 line. The verdict and card status are unchanged.

step_checks.checker_grade: REFUTED AS STATED; PROVED only for trees of diameter <= 5
step_checks.reason: Counterexample on the seat's own host. Labelled non-backtracking 6-walks are pattern-blind, but they count 2 x (six-link path copies) + (closed 6-walks round rings). So the number of alternating-label six-link paths is 1664 - 6 N_F. I checked this on 120 random patterns of the 26-site host, and the general identity sum_P6 f + sum_rings sum_cuts f = const with random weights f (0 exceptions). The seat checked paths of only 1-5 links. Consequence: at order h^12 a six-link path, a tree that touches no ring, carries pattern energy. The correct per-ring price is W_ring - sum over 6 cuts of W_P6.

The lap is exactly -64/3113912109375 = -0.20580 J6 (own carved-ring run; equals -12 kappa^2 t^6/A^7, A = 9/20). The t^6 and t^8 loop formulas re-derived by hand: on the two-ON subgraph (a union of loops) only winding walks see the pattern, giving 12 per 6-loop at t^6, and 96 per 6-loop plus 16 per 8-loop at t^8. 6-loops = all-ON rings on every pattern checked.

step_checks.reason: Own exact series to h^14 reproduce every class weight: all zero through h^10 and first at h^12, for all 64 patterns, equal within classes. F is +2.0462e-10 J6 at h^12 (+2.0451e-10 to h^14), A6 +3.45e-14, O6 +5.26e-16. As PRICES the six-path deficit must be subtracted. Then F = +2.841e-10 J6 (+39%), and the other 12 classes become -2.0e-17 to -1.4e-12 J6, small GAINS rather than costs. Each alternating six-link path weighs -10.197 h^12; 6 cuts give -7.95e-11 J6.
